name: Ritz-Carlton Beijing, Financial Street
insider_take: Where imperial grandeur meets modern luxury in the heart of China's financial powerhouse
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Beijing sits atop floors 83-77 of the iconic China World Trade Center Tower III, making it one of the world's highest hotels. The property features stunning views of the Forbidden City and offers butler service on the Club Level floors - a rarity in Beijing's luxury scene.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 80+ for unobstructed views of Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, especially magical at sunset when the ancient architecture glows golden against Beijing's modern skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel's Cepe Italian Restaurant on the 82nd floor offers some of Beijing's most romantic dining with panoramic city views, while the nearby Financial Street district houses the headquarters of China's major banks and is walking distance to the historic Xicheng District's traditional hutongs.
pros: Prime Financial Street location with easy access to business district
Exceptional Ritz-Carlton service standards and attention to detail
Luxurious accommodations with sophisticated Chinese-inspired design
Part of Marriott's STARS Program offering exclusive amenities and upgrades
cons: Business district location may feel removed from cultural attractions
Ultra-luxury positioning reflects premium pricing structure
